doc.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

title: His mother's reaction and Emerson's dog Moose
summary: Parents' view of his music, car accidents and the dog Moose on gigs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did your mother say about it?

All I remember her saying, and this is kind of strange, she said, “Why are you taking English?” Now she, both my parents were very happy that I was playing music. They had no idea really of how much traveling I was doing back and forth. And we never got in any trouble and we only had a couple of car accidents.
I heard this story last night about coming back from, I think it was Cornell, and some Great Dane puppy ended up in the car? Was this before or after you?
I think it was before me. I don’t remember any Great Dane puppy.
All right. It was called Moose or something.

Oh no, that was Emerson’s dog. It wasn’t a Great Dane, it was a sandy colored mutt. And yeah, and Emerson would take the dog with him on gigs. And I don’t know, there were some problems sometimes and Moose would jump out of the car I guess. But we did have fun.
